pageTitle: Share "Divine Ingenuity: Collector's Chapter" Custom Domain to Win Primogems!
name: Share "Divine Ingenuity: Collector's Chapter" Custom Domain to Win Primogems!
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ The "Divine Ingenuity: Collector's Chapter" event is now available. Travelers can once again explore this mysterious Domain~ In this event, Travelers can still artifice your own Domains and invite other Travelers to experience them. I wonder what creative Custom Domains our Travelers have created this time. Come share with me! Participants will have a chance to win Primogems or merchandise rewards!
